title: Rocket ship with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rocket body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="16" ry="28" fill="#f0f4ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="16" ry="28" fill="none" stroke="#c8d8ff" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <path d="M50 10 Q34 22 34 34 L66 34 Q66 22 50 10 Z" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <path d="M50 10 Q34 22 34 34 L66 34 Q66 22 50 10 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ff9a9a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="8" fill="#4ecdc4"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#a8f0eb" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="35" r="2.5" fill="#c8fff9"/>
  <!-- smiley face on body -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#3a3a6a"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#3a3a6a"/>
  <path d="M42 63 Q50 70 58 63" fill="none" stroke="#3a3a6a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left fin -->
  <path d="M34 50 L22 72 L34 68 Z" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <path d="M34 50 L22 72 L34 68 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ff9a9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- right fin -->
  <path d="M66 50 L78 72 L66 68 Z" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <path d="M66 50 L78 72 L66 68 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ff9a9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- bottom nozzle -->
  <rect x="43" y="74" width="14" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <rect x="43" y="74" width="14" height="8" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#ffd88a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- flames -->
  <path d="M44 82 Q47 95 50 88 Q53 95 56 82 Z" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <path d="M46 84 Q49 92 50 87 Q51 92 54 84 Z" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <!-- stars -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="30" r="2" fill="#ffe66d"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#ffe66d"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="48" r="2" fill="#ffe66d"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#ffe66d"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#ffe66d"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="42" r="1" fill="#ffe66d"/>
</svg>
